cellacdc/myutils.doc:
Helper library of Cell-ACDC without windows of its own (it replaces the single module myutils.py), split by theme: filesystem.py (experiments, files, recent paths), app_info.py (version, git, logging), installs.py (pip/conda, check_install_package), model_installs.py (check_install_<model>, GPU checks), segm_models.py (model and tracker registry, ArgSpec, init), downloads.py (URLs, model weights, manual, ffmpeg), image_utils.py (dtype conversions, TIFF), table_utils.py (acdc_df helpers), misc.py (small Python helpers), model_modules.py (Qt-free model introspection, was myutils_models.py) and torch_utils.py (PyTorch install and device helpers, was _torch_utils.py). Helpers with a single program part as user live next to it: gui/helpers.py, data_structure/helpers.py, launcher/main_window.py (self-update), fiji_macros/__init__.py (Fiji), qutils.py (setRetainSizePolicy), help/about.py, help/welcome.py and the utilities in utils/.

Every module imports without Qt: Qt classes and the shared message box and push buttons are imported under if GUI_INSTALLED, dialogs only inside the functions that open them.

This __init__ imports no submodule. Its __getattr__ forwards the plugin API (the names that custom models, trackers and promptable models use as myutils.<name>, listed in the PLUGIN_API table of _compat_moves.py) without a warning, imports a submodule when its name is accessed, and forwards every other name of the old myutils.py with a MovedWarning (DeprecationWarning). Cell-ACDC code imports the submodule that defines a name and never uses the forwarding.

cellacdc/myutils/filesystem.py.doc: Finding experiments and files: Position and Images folder detection, listdir, channel and basename lookup, the status of a Position (Cell-ACDC and spotMAX), the recent-path CSV files (also those of the GUI's "export current view"), resetting the user settings, and opening folders or URLs in the operating system. Imports load.py at module level and the shared message box (shared/widgets/message_box.py) under if GUI_INSTALLED.

cellacdc/myutils/app_info.py.doc: About the running Cell-ACDC: its version (read_version, from setuptools_scm or _version.py), release date, git branch and remotes, the Linux distribution, the version and system info text, and the log files (the Logger stdout tee, StdErr, setupLogger, get_logs_path and deleting old log files).

cellacdc/myutils/installs.py.doc: Installing third-party packages: version checks of installed packages, pip and conda commands and their runners (_install_pip_package, _run_command), normalising package specs, check_install_package with the special installers (_SPECIAL_INSTALLERS, _PKG_SPEC_KEYS), the command-line and GUI install prompts, and the checks for server mode and a running GUI. Plugin API, forwarded by myutils/__init__.py without a warning: check_install_package, is_server_mode, _raise_server_missing, _install_package_msg, get_package_version. Under if GUI_INSTALLED it imports QCoreApplication and the shared message box of the GUI install prompts (shared/widgets/message_box.py); it imports no dialog.

cellacdc/myutils/model_installs.py.doc: Whether the environment of a segmentation model or tracker is ready: the check_install_<model> functions (plugin API), the Cellpose version helpers, _CONVPAINT_PACKAGES, the GPU framework checks (also run with the Python of a model environment through a subprocess template, which works with the myutils package and with the single myutils.py of older versions), check_gpu_available (plugin API) and the GPU install prompt. Built on installs.py and on torch_utils.py (check_install_torch). The message box and push buttons of the GPU install prompt (shared/widgets/message_box.py, push_buttons.py) are imported under if GUI_INSTALLED.

cellacdc/myutils/segm_models.py.doc: Segmentation models, promptable models and trackers: the custom-model registry and the instructions for adding models, the lists of available models and trackers, importing their modules, ArgSpec and parameter introspection, initialising models and trackers, and logging the segmentation parameters. Plugin API: getModelArgSpecFromEnv, resolve_segm_model_init_data. The Qt-free model introspection used by service/worker.py and the model environments is model_modules.py, whose ArgSpec is a different namedtuple.

cellacdc/myutils/downloads.py.doc: Downloads: the generic URL and zip helpers, locating and downloading model weights (get_model_path is plugin API; download_model, _model_url and the _download_<model> functions), moving models from the old user-profile location, the user manual and ffmpeg. Example data: help/welcome.py; Java and Bio-Formats: data_structure/helpers.py; Fiji: fiji_macros/__init__.py.

cellacdc/myutils/image_utils.py.doc: Image and array helpers: dtype conversions (to_uint8, to_uint16 and img_to_float are plugin API), writing TIFF files with metadata, bounds checks, iterating over axes, finding an object by its label, synthetic test images and the input/output index mapper used by core.py.

cellacdc/myutils/table_utils.py.doc: Helpers for acdc_output tables (acdc_df) and other DataFrames: base and empty tables, checked index resets, the per-frame stored-data dict, the default segmInfo table, and converting Cell Tracking Challenge tracking output to an acdc_df. Plugin API: df_ctc_to_acdc_df, checked_reset_index, checked_reset_index_Cell_ID.

cellacdc/myutils/misc.py.doc: Small general-purpose Python helpers, standard library only: text formatting (salute, trimmed lists and dicts, elided text, ETA, byte sizes), iteration helpers, chained attributes, safe attribute access and calling with fewer keyword arguments. translateStrNone and try_kwargs are plugin API.

cellacdc/gui/helpers.py.doc: Non-UI helpers used only by the main GUI window (gui/main_window/) and its private ID widgets (gui/widgets/edit_toolbars.py): objects touching the border (clear_border, get_edge_ids), slices of a local array into the global one, acdc_df dtype fixes, checking the input of the trackers, formatting lists of IDs and sorting IDs by distance. The modules shared with the measurements viewer (gui/mixins/, measurements_viewer/) never import this module.

cellacdc/data_structure/helpers.py.doc: Helpers of the data structure module (data_structure/data_struct.py and its dialogs), without widgets of their own: the git check, locating, downloading and installing the Java JDK, javabridge and the Bio-Formats jar, the operating-system specific install commands and the instruction texts shown by installJavaDialog (data_structure/dialogs/metadata.py), and findalliter. The git check and the javabridge help show the shared message box (shared/widgets/message_box.py, imported under if GUI_INSTALLED); install_java imports installJavaDialog inside the function.

notes: Placement: myutils design (journal agent a239656113ad8d4b4) with the consistency corrections (aa91c413f4552a948, synthesis R2): are_acdc_dfs_equal -> gui/workers/loading_saving.py (next to AutoSaveWorker), get_cca_colname_desc and format_cca_manual_changes -> gui/dialogs/editing.py (next to editCcaTableWidget), clipSelemMask -> gui/widgets/main_window_items.py (next to LabelRoiCircularItem). R3: ArgSpec -> myutils/segm_models.py, _PKG_SPEC_KEYS and _SPECIAL_INSTALLERS -> myutils/installs.py (they already follow the four _install_* functions in source order, which the tool keeps), _CONVPAINT_PACKAGES -> myutils/model_installs.py (before check_install_convpaint). R15: gui/helpers.py holds only the 10 guiWin-only helpers; nearest_ID_to_centroid (gui_utils) is the gui shard's.

myutils.py becomes the package cellacdc/myutils/ in C8: every top-level statement is mapped, the old file is removed, and myutils/__init__.py is the facade (packages entry). The moves shard moves myutils_models.py -> myutils/model_modules.py and _torch_utils.py -> myutils/torch_utils.py in the same commit, with alias shims at the old paths.

The two items "stmt:if GUI_INSTALLED:" and "stmt:if GUI_INSTALLED or RUNNING_AS_SERVER:" are blocks that hold only imports. They are listed for coverage, but the tool must treat them as guarded imports (import generation: copied with their guard, filtered to the free names of the receiving module), never cut them byte-exact. Expected result: installs.py gets "if GUI_INSTALLED: from qtpy.QtCore import QCoreApplication" (used by is_gui_running and testQcoreApp); segm_models.py gets "if GUI_INSTALLED or RUNNING_AS_SERVER: from .. import config" (used by store_custom_model_path, store_custom_promptable_model_path, get_list_of_models, get_list_of_promptable_models; test_headless_server_config_import checks hasattr(segm_models, "config")). QMessageBox, QPlainTextEdit (only a string annotation in Logger), Signal and QObject are unused and dropped. No myutils submodule imports widgets or apps at module level.

Intended non-byte-exact edits in C8 (record them in changes.jsonl): (a) every use of the guarded "widgets"/"apps" modules becomes a function-level import of the new home module, used through its alias: myMessageBox (shared/widgets/message_box.py) in checkDataIntegrity, check_git_installed, install_javabridge_help, check_napari_plugin, _inform_install_package_failed, _install_package_gui_msg, _warn_install_gpu; okPushButton and cancelPushButton (shared/widgets/push_buttons.py) in _warn_install_gpu; installJavaDialog (data_structure/dialogs/metadata.py) in install_java; downloadModel (shared/dialogs/model_selection.py), QDialogModelParams (shared/dialogs/model_params.py), BayesianTrackerParamsWin, CellACDCTrackerParamsWin, DeltaTrackerParamsWin (shared/dialogs/tracker_params.py) in init_tracker. (b) The base module-level "from . import core, load" is not kept: load is imported inside filesystem.getChannelFilePath, filesystem.getBasenameAndChNames and segm_models.resolve_segm_model_init_data, core inside table_utils.df_ctc_to_acdc_df. (c) image_utils.img_to_float imports _warnings inside the function; _warnings and debugutils import installs inside their functions (cycle cuts). (d) The subprocess templates (model_installs._available_gpu_frameworks_from_env, service/environment.py _RUNTIME_CHECK_CODE, is_cellacdc_cli_installed, _check_environment_dependencies) check hasattr(<cellacdc myutils module>, "__path__") and use the old single-module path otherwise; keep the "_available_gpu_frameworks(True, False)" substring. (e) volume_renderer/utils.download_3d_renderer_demo_data imports myutils/downloads.py and data_path inside the function. (f) help/about.py drops its from-imports of the two moved version-command builders, fiji_macros/__init__.py its myutils import. (g) Function-level relative imports gain one level inside myutils/ (IS_CLONED, __version__, _version, _types, user_data_dir, user_home_path, acdc_regex, config). (h) model_installs calls torch_utils.check_install_torch() through the module alias so that tests can patch it.

print_call_stack is not defined in myutils.py at the base: plot.py:168 and whitelist.py:735 call myutils.print_call_stack(), which raises AttributeError today. The item maps it to debugutils.py in C1, where both call sites are rewritten to debugutils.print_call_stack (plot.py then no longer imports myutils). It is not a cut: the coverage check must accept this one key without a base definition.

The 9 _torch_utils names in plugin_api are re-exports at the base ("from ._torch_utils import (...)", not items): the facade forwards them to myutils/torch_utils.py. All other plugin_api names are items of this shard. Plugin API homes: installs (check_install_package, is_server_mode, _raise_server_missing, _install_package_msg, get_package_version); model_installs (check_install_<13 models>, get_cellpose_major_version, check_gpu_available); image_utils (to_uint8, to_uint16, img_to_float); misc (translateStrNone, try_kwargs); table_utils (df_ctc_to_acdc_df, checked_reset_index, checked_reset_index_Cell_ID); downloads (get_model_path); segm_models (getModelArgSpecFromEnv, resolve_segm_model_init_data); torch_utils (check_install_torch, get_torch_device, BASE_PYTORCH_LINK, get_driver_cuda_version, get_min_compute_cap, get_pytorch_command, get_torch_options, get_torch_options_safe, resolve_torch_link). Checked against every myutils.<name> and from-import in models/, trackers/, promptable_models/ and docs/ at the base: all are covered; _CONVPAINT_PACKAGES appears there only in a comment (models/_env_config.py) and warns. In-repo plugins are still rewritten to the submodules.

Kept in a themed myutils module although a single program part uses them (cohesion, synthesis 2.1 rule 5): the pos-status trio, the recent-path family, the model registry/ArgSpec family, import_promptable_segment_module/init_prompt_segm_model, get_trimmed_list/_bytes_to_GB, getBasename. Kept because their only user is a library module: get_input_output_mapper (core), safe_get_or_call (acdc_bioio reader), check_matplotlib_version and reset_settings (__main__), parse_model_params and _parse_bool_str (cli), get_chained_attr (autopilot), is_pkg_version_within_range (_run), _run_command and get_cli_multi_choice_question (_torch_utils), download_ffmpeg (exporters), remove_known_extension (load), check_install_custom_dependencies (preprocess).

Users checked at the base for every helper leaving myutils/: gui/helpers.py members are used only by gui.py, widgets IDsLineEdit/KeptObjectIDsList (-> gui/widgets/edit_toolbars.py) and tests (test_id_distances, test_lineage_tree_reset); the other clear_border hits are skimage.segmentation.clear_border. The Java command/instruction helpers are used by installJavaDialog (-> data_structure/dialogs/metadata.py) and dataStruct.py. The utility helpers are used by their utility module or by its worker, which the workers shard moves into the same utility module (ResizeUtilWorker -> utils/resize/util.py, reaching validate_images_path in utils/resize/__init__.py).

Module aliases: myutils submodules use their bare names (no clash with existing module names or local variables in cellacdc/ and tests/); gui/helpers.py is gui_helpers (cli.py has local variables named helpers), data_structure/helpers.py is data_structure_helpers. Aliases given for modules of other shards follow synthesis rule 8 and the existing import names (about, welcome, fiji_macros, resize, volume_renderer_utils, launcher_window, gui_custom_annotations, gui_overlay, gui_dialogs_editing, gui_widgets_main_window_items, gui_workers_loading_saving); the owning shard wins on a mismatch.

The facade (myutils/__init__.py) is generated: _SUBMODULES (the 9 themed submodules plus model_modules and torch_utils), _PLUGIN_API (plugin_api below, forwarded on every access, no warning, no caching) and every other old name, including ArgSpec, _CONVPAINT_PACKAGES, _PKG_SPEC_KEYS and _SPECIAL_INSTALLERS, forwarded with a MovedWarning. No cellacdc globals (printl, *_path, is_win, ...) or stdlib modules are forwarded. __dir__ = plugin API + submodule names. Unmapped names raise AttributeError.

Integration: the two import-only blocks (stmt:if GUI_INSTALLED: and stmt:if GUI_INSTALLED or RUNNING_AS_SERVER:) are not mapped as items: mapped import blocks move byte-exact (README), which put the whole guarded block, including `from . import widgets, apps`, into installs.py. Unmapped, the codemod copies each guarded import with its reconstructed guard into the submodules that use the name, filtered to those names.
